matchup.plan_md:
**Plan line:** 2 adds.

**Score:** **821 to 777**, up 44.
- On 18 Nov we scored 278 against a projected 425. They scored 373 against 361.
- **Projection with no more moves:** **1,699 to 1,687**, from `matchup.py` with no swap.
- ESPN sync: CJ McCollum and Brook Lopez dropped, Kyle Kuzma picked up. Our roster is unchanged.
- **The Fears claim (drop Bamba) is still pending.** It processes at 3:00 AM ET 19 Nov, 7:00 PM Thu 19 Melbourne.

**Our injuries:**
- **Cade Cunningham** sat 18 Nov with right knee soreness. He "will presumably be back" Friday vs TOR ([CBS/RotoWire, 18 Nov](https://www.cbssports.com/fantasy/basketball/news/pistons-cade-cunningham-ruled-out-wednesday-539841/)); *ESPN est.* 20 Nov.
- **Scottie Barnes** sat 18 Nov for planned "groin injury management", with three games in four nights ([Global News, 18 Nov](https://globalnews.ca/news/12156562/raptors-forward-barnes-out-against-wizards/)); *ESPN est.* 20 Nov.
- **Kawhi Leonard** (*ESPN est.* 27 Nov) and **Jalen Duren** (*ESPN est.* 24 Nov) are unchanged.

**The options, 19–22 Nov** (they score 910 more):

| Option | Adds for the plan | Our lineup | Projected final |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| No claim | 5 | 1,002 (878 + 123.6) | about 1,823 to 1,687 |
| Claim Fears, drop Jenkins | 4 | 975 (874 + 100.9) | about 1,796 to 1,687 |
| **Claim Fears, drop Bamba** | 2 | 956 (882 + 74.2) | about 1,777 to 1,687 |
| No moves | — | 878 | 1,699 to 1,687 |

**Every plan with moves projects a win.**
- Dropping Bamba costs about 46 against no claim, and about 19 against dropping Jenkins.
- Jaxson Hayes is off ESPN's injury list, so Bamba's start is likely over and his rate overstates him.
- **Risk:** Cunningham and Barnes. If both miss 20 Nov and Cunningham also misses 22 Nov, about 150 comes off our side.

**After the claim, 2 adds, +74.2** (ESPN dates, Melbourne times):
1. **20 Nov:** drop Gobert after his game vs NY ends (tip-off Fri 20, 12:00 PM). Add **Quentin Grimes** (LAL) before his game vs SAC (Sat 21, 2:00 PM).
   - Only if Austin Reaves is still out; *ESPN est.* now 20 Nov.
2. **21 Nov:** drop Grimes after his game. Add **Neemias Queta** (BOS) before BOS @SAC (Sun 22, 2:00 PM).

**If Reaves is back:** 1 add, +39.0. On 21 Nov, Gobert → **Queta**, before BOS @SAC.
